quests.title: The Second Stillness
quests.journal: Catnap in Cypress shore.

lines.offer: Last time we sat still together. This time, sleep. A nap in the cypress shade. I'll keep watch. Badly, probably.
lines.done: You slept, and the roots grew a little. Neither of you tried.

quests.title: Map Party
quests.journal: Identify 10 Little Briar species in the book.

lines.offer: We want our map to have fish on it! Real ones! Can your book show ten kinds from Little Briar?
lines.done: I drew a frog in the corner. It's a friendly frog.

quests.title: Lantern Watch
quests.journal: Record Old Lantern.

lines.offer: When I was small, I saw a fish under the landing glowing like a lamp. Old Lantern. Nobody believes me but Grandmother. Find him?
lines.done: Gold. Just as gold as I remembered. Thank you for not laughing.

quests.title: Paint the Queen
quests.journal: Anchor in Lily cove for 30 game minutes while it's misty.

lines.offer: Wait with me in the lily cove in the mist? I want to paint the moment before she rises.
lines.done: No queen today, and I painted the mist anyway. It's the best one I've done.

quests.title: Birdhouse Row
quests.journal: Visit Cypress shore, South rocks and Creek inlet.

lines.offer: Three birdhouses, three snags, and I've built them all. I just can't stay awake long enough to deliver them. Would you?
lines.done: Wrens moved in already. Fastest tenants I've ever had.

quests.title: Swim Buddy
quests.journal: Travel 200 m in Open water.

lines.offer: Paddle alongside me across the open water? Everyone else just stares.
lines.done: See? Perfectly normal. Here, a little thing I think about while floating.

quests.title: Rainy-Day Ears
quests.journal: Anchor anywhere on Little Briar for 30 game minutes while it rains.

lines.offer: Confession: I hate rain on my ears. Could I shelter under your boat next time it rains?
lines.done: Dry ears! You're a hero. Have my old swim cap. It's lucky.

quests.title: Heron Clock
quests.journal: Bot scouts South rocks.

lines.offer: The herons tell the hour by the rocks. Have your Bot look at the south rocks and tell me what he sees.
lines.done: Herons stand there when the shade's just so. That's three o'clock. Told you.

quests.title: A Loon for Gus
quests.journal: Visit Big open water on Flathead, then tell Gus.

lines.offer: I heard there are loons up north. Haven't heard a loon since I was young. If you ever go, listen for me?
lines.done: You heard one? (quiet) Thank you. Take the bell; I don't ring it anymore.

quests.title: Taste Test
quests.journal: Catch any fish on dough balls.

lines.offer: New recipe. Will fish eat it? Take a dozen, put it on a line, tell me honestly.
lines.done: They ATE it?! I'm putting it in the shop.

quests.title: Cookout Bread
quests.journal: Attend the Sunday cookout at Briar Landing.

lines.offer: Sunday cookout, I'm bringing bread. Come eat some so I'm not the only one.
lines.done: You came! Here, a loaf-shaped buoy. It floats better than my real bread.

quests.title: Practice Buoys
quests.journal: Pass the 4 practice buoys in order in Clear Creek coves.

lines.offer: My practice buoys are in the sheltered cove. Follow them at your own pace, round and back.
lines.done: Lovely line! You've got whisker-sense for open water. Have my whistle.

quests.title: Squeak Test
quests.journal: Use the Wave Chime on Cedar Creek.

lines.offer: Is the duck squeaking right? Ring the chime somewhere on Cedar and tell me if the fish complain!
done: HA! A fish came up! HA!

quests.title: The Last Verse
quests.journal: Witness the Whiskered Guardian.

lines.offer: If you ever see the Guardian, tell me how it looked. Then I'll have my last verse.
lines.done: Its whiskers wrote the twilight on the water. There. Finished. Keep this copy.

quests.title: Cedar Census
quests.journal: Identify 20 Cedar Creek species in the book.

lines.offer: I'm compiling a census of Cedar. Help me reach twenty species? I'll name the next one after you. Kidding. After my aunt Beatrix.
lines.done: Twenty! Take my old notebook, every page has a fish and an aunt.

quests.title: Treasure Tour
quests.journal: Visit Flooded shoreline, Dam riprap and Creek channels, then talk to Patch.

lines.offer: Treasure hunt! Flooded shoreline, dam riprap, creek channels. Then come back and I'll tell you what I found.
lines.done: Found it! My lucky spoon! …You keep it. You were luckier for me than it ever was.

quests.title: Night Line
quests.journal: Premium or heavy line · Chicken liver · Creek channels · 60 active minutes, then check it.

lines.offer: Set a good line in the creek channels with liver and leave it an hour. Let's see if you've got the patience. I don't, these days.
done: Not bad. Not bad at all.

quests.title: Believe Me
quests.journal: Record the Channel Leviathan.

lines.offer: Catch the Leviathan. Then nobody can tell me I dreamed it.
lines.done: (long pause) I'm not crying. Take my lantern. I won't need proof anymore.

quests.title: Under the Pecans
quests.journal: Catch 3 fish in Flooded shoreline.

lines.offer: My pecan trees shade the flooded shoreline. Catch three fish under them so I know they're useful.
lines.done: Shade AND fish. Good trees.

quests.title: Pie for Everyone
quests.journal: Attend the Sunday cookout at Cedar Landing.

lines.offer: Sunday I'm bringing pie to the cookout. You'll come? You won't ask for the recipe?
lines.done: You didn't ask! You're my favorite. Here's a charm, not the recipe.

quests.title: Lamps on the Pool
quests.journal: After 7 pm, pass the 3 lamp buoys around the Marked Pool in order.

lines.offer: Ride with me around the three lamp buoys tonight. I like company while I check them.
lines.done: All three bright. The pool is happy.

quests.title: Lullaby
quests.journal: Record the Spillway Monster.

lines.offer: I sing to the big blue every night. I would love to see who I've been singing to.
lines.done: (humming) There you are, big one. Thank you, Skipper. Keep the old lamp glass.

quests.title: Ranger Check
quests.journal: Visit Upper lake flats, Clear Creek coves and Caney Creek landing.

lines.offer: Ranger check: visit the flats, the coves and the landing, and say 'all clear' at each! I'm practicing!
done: All clear, all clear, all clear! You're a natural.
(she tips her paddleboat in the shallows, laughing)

quests.title: Badge Day
quests.journal: Standard or better line · Nightcrawlers · Upper lake flats · 60 active minutes, then talk to Kit.

lines.offer: Last badge! I have to teach someone a whole fishing line. Set one on the flats with worms and let it soak an hour, then show me!
lines.done: I'M A RANGER! You get my practice badge. You earned it too.

day: Welcome back, dear. The kettle's on and the coves are quiet.
Ah, {BotName}. Your collar's crooked. There. Better.
greetings.weather:drizzle: A good soaking for the lines. Come under the porch roof.
greetings.weather:mist: Mist on the lilies. That's when the shy ones come out.
greetings.after_ch5: There's my author. What did the lake tell you today?
greetings.cookout: Everyone's here! Sit, sit. Bring a fish if you like. Bring yourself regardless.

greetings.first: Ahoy, Skipper! Welcome to Doc's Lonely Star Marina! What can I get your rig?
greetings.day: Wind's off the main channel today. Read it with your whiskers, then check my gauges.
greetings.weather:drizzle: Rain's good for catfish and bad for my knees!
greetings.after_ch2: Marked Pool's busy. Folks say a Skipper found it. Wonder who.

greetings.day: Peace upon your bow, Skipper. The water reflects the clouds without holding them.
greetings.friend: Ah, my napping colleague. The dragonflies asked after you.

letters: Dear Skipper, the dragonflies are back. My tail says hello. — Moss

greetings.friend: Skipper! Life jacket? Yes! Good! Hi, {BotName}! Hi, frog-Bot!
The moon's good tonight, Skipper. I'm not scared of the landing anymore. Mostly.
Look, another heron. I'm going to paint it. Don't judge me.
(yawning) Oh, Skipper. I was just resting my eyes. For an hour.

greetings.day: Hello! Don't mind me, I'm swimming. Cats can swim, you know. Some of us adore it.
greetings.friend: Water's lovely today! Come in! No? Fine, I'll swim by your boat.

day: Afternoon. Ferried cats across this lake forty years. Never once lost.

greetings.day: Fresh dough balls! Don't drop crumbs. Please don't drop crumbs.

greetings.friend: There's my best student. Slow and pretty, Skipper.
Skipper! I built a silent winch! It's… mostly silent!
Skipper, I've been very quiet all morning. Three whole minutes.
Hello, colleague. Aunt Beatrix says hello. She's a drum.
Skipper! Found three lures and a sock today. Want the sock?
Evening, Skipper. Look at that sunset. (sniff) Wind again.

letters: Skipper. Saw a good sunset. Thought of you. Wind's fine. — H.

greetings.day: Hi, sugar! Want a pecan? I have nine hundred.
Good evening. The pool is calm and the edges are lit. Fish here safely.
greetings.friend: Skipper. The pool says hello. In a very deep voice.

letters: The big one sang back last night. Truly. — Luz

greetings.day: Junior Ranger Kit! Life jacket check! …Pass!
greetings.friend: Ranger Kit reporting! Life jacket? Good! Me? …Also good! Probably!

lines.greeting: Ahoy, Skipper! Forty years on riverboats, and you know what I learned? Slow turns win.
lines.offer: Take a long, easy run across the open water with me. Your own pace. I want to see how you hold a line.
